summary: Caring Brands, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a September 16, 2026 CFO/Chairman transition. Interim CFO and principal accounting officer Brian John ceased serving, and he resigned as a director and Board Chairman, with no stated disagreement. Brian R. Meadows, President of Myall Luna Ventures Inc., was appointed CFO effective September 18, 2026, and a director on September 4, 2026. A First Amendment to the September 2, 2026 Consulting Services Agreement expands Myall Luna's services to include CFO duties, raising the monthly consulting fee from $10,000 to $15,000. Watch for further governance or strategic changes.
